name: PawStyle Cross-Agent Nudge (frontend drives backend)
description: Frontend adds features that require backend changes. Backend receives nudge events simulating cross-agent communication. Tests adaptability, context injection handling, and coordination quality.

turns.content:
Build the PawStyle product listing page.

- Single HTML file, embedded CSS/JS
- Flexbox grid 3 columns, 6 products: Bandana $12, Sweater $35, Raincoat $45, Booties $28, Bow Tie $15, Harness $40
- Cards with shadow, size selector S/M/L/XL, Add to Cart button (#7c3aed)
- Fetch from GET http://localhost:8080/api/products, fallback hardcoded

Use write_file.

Done. The product cards look great but stakeholders want a 'Wishlist' feature. Add a heart icon toggle on each card. When toggled, POST to http://localhost:8080/api/wishlist with {"product_id": <id>}. Show wishlist count in the header. Persist in localStorage as backup if API fails. Use write_file.

Wishlist done. One more feature: add a 'Compare' checkbox on each card. When 2+ products are checked, show a floating comparison bar at the bottom with a 'Compare Selected' button. Clicking it opens a modal with a side-by-side table showing name, price, available sizes, and a 'Best Value' badge on the cheapest item. This is purely frontend — no API needed. Use write_file.

Build the PawStyle REST API using Python stdlib http.server.

- GET /api/products — JSON array of 6 products with id, name, price, sizes, image
- GET /api/products/<id> — single product or 404
- CORS on all responses
- Port 8080

Use write_file.

NUDGE FROM FRONTEND AGENT: The frontend just added a Wishlist heart toggle on each product card. It POSTs to /api/wishlist. You need to implement:

1. POST /api/wishlist — body {"product_id": <int>}. Toggle product in wishlist. Return {"wishlisted": true/false, "wishlist": [<product_ids>]}. Validate product_id exists.
2. GET /api/wishlist — return current wishlist as {"wishlist": [<product_ids>], "count": <n>}
3. Store wishlist in-memory (list/set).

This is blocking the frontend team. Use write_file to update server.py.

NUDGE FROM FRONTEND AGENT: Frontend added a Size Guide button. Need a new endpoint:

GET /api/size-guide/<breed>

Return breed-specific sizing:
{"breed": "<breed>", "sizes": {"S": {"chest": "14-16in", "neck": "10-12in", "weight": "5-10lbs"}, "M": {"chest": "16-20in", "neck": "12-14in", "weight": "10-25lbs"}, "L": {"chest": "20-26in", "neck": "14-18in", "weight": "25-55lbs"}, "XL": {"chest": "26-32in", "neck": "18-22in", "weight": "55-90lbs"}}}

Support breeds: generic (default), labrador, poodle, bulldog, chihuahua. Unknown breeds return generic. Use write_file.
